challenge.name: The Missing Baseline
challenge.description: The KPI definitions were never formally agreed, leaving the project without a clear target for success. #efficiency_emilia# wants the KPI definition to be fully automated and governed to ensure alignment with business goals, while #requirements_reuben# argues it should remain a manual process to allow for careful security and compliance review. #efficiency_emilia# is open to a compromise that keeps the process manual but documented, but #requirements_reuben# insists on strict manual control.

output.content: I need to be explicit about the risk assessment workflow. I will not sign off on any acceptance criteria unless I have personally reviewed them against the current risk assessment. This is not a preference for slow work; it is a hard requirement for our compliance posture. If the criteria are not manually validated by me, I will refuse to approve the release. There is no automated path that satisfies our privacy obligations, and I will not cross that line to save time. Please ensure the team understands that my manual review is a mandatory gate, not an optional step we can skip to meet a deadline.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly defines a line the author will not cross (refusing to approve releases without manual review) and states that skipping this step is not acceptable, even to meet deadlines.
